english:
[My] prayer. [Mankunk] of the Cross, from the tone.
Midday hymn [Tone] Plagal 4 [Dk]: "Who art unoriginated" (Որ անսկիզբն [Or anskizbn]). Mesedi Psalm 97 [98]: "All [the ends of the earth] have seen".
Epistle: Romans 4:1 "What then shall we say" to verse 12 "of our father Abraham."
Alleluia: "Have mercy on me". Gospel according to Matthew 9:27 "And as [Jesus] passed by" to verse 34 "He casts out demons."

Canon of Saint Gregory our Enlightener, on his coming out of the pit.
Saturday: Feast of Saint Gregory our Enlightener, on his coming out of the pit. In the evening, perform a pre-festive service [Nakhatonak]: "O blessed one" with its proper canons. And in the night: Night office hymn, [Tone] 2 [Bz]: "O blessed one". "King forever", "Today the ranks". Canticle of the Fathers [Harts], [Tone] 2 [Bz]: "Who sent" with its proper canons. [Mankunk], [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Wonderful God" and "Who were called".
Midday Introit: "Rejoice today". Hymn, [Tone] Plagal 3 [Gk]: "Good Shepherd". Psalm 39 [40]: "He drew me up from the pit". Proverbs / Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 "Then the righteous man" to verse 8 "profitable for us".
Prophet Isaiah 60:20 "And shall be ended" to 61:7 "upon their heads".
Epistle: Hebrews 13:17 "Obey [your leaders]" to verse 21 "forever, amen." Alleluia: "You are a priest". Gospel according to Matthew 19:27 "Then answered" to verse 29 "shall inherit."
In the evening: "Joyous Light". Mesedi: "I loved", "Because He inclined". "Holy God, who wast crucified." And they shall vest together and go out into the chancel. Dismissal hymn [Hambartsi], [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Rejoice, O Holy Church". After this, Litany: "Let us ask", "Save". Prayer: "King of peace".

Second Sunday after the Descent of the Holy Spirit: [Tone] Plagal 4 [Dk]. Feast of the Catholic Holy Church of Etchmiadzin, which our holy father Gregory the Enlightener established upon his coming out of the pit. Night office hymn, [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Rejoice, O Holy Church". Canticle of the Fathers [Harts], [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Today Bright". Magnificat, [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Of the Unoriginated Word". Song: "To Your House", Verse: "The Lord reigns". Litany: "Let us say". "Holy God, who wast crucified." And they shall go forth with the Cross and the Gospel in procession, singing the hymn, [Tone] Plagal 4 [Dk]: "The Only-Begotten descended from the Father". Psalm 117 [118]: "This is the day", Verse: "Give thanks".
Proverbs 9:1 "Wisdom has built" to verse 6 "understanding with knowledge."
Prophet Zechariah 3:7 "Thus says the Lord" to 4:9 "me unto you."
Epistle: Hebrews 9:1 "Indeed, [the first covenant] had" to verse 10 "were imposed".
Alleluia: "How lovely are". Gospel according to John 10:22 "And it was at that time" to verse 30 "I and my Father are one." And they shall sign with the Cross the four corners of the world [Andastan]. Litany: "By Your Holy Cross". Prayer: "Keep us". And then they shall begin the Hymn of Rest, [Tone] Plagal 4 [Dk]: "King of Glory", "Holy Virgin Mother of God", "Who art unoriginated from the Existent", Glory to the Father. Psalm 129 [130]: "Out of the depths I cried". Gospel according to Matthew 13:31 "Another parable" to verse 35 "from the foundation of the world." For the Souls. "For the departed". "O Christ, Son of God".
After this: "Newly-created". Litany: "Let us ask", "Save". Prayer: "To Your All-powerful".
Midday Introit: "Peace [to all]". Hymn, [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Today rejoicing". Psalm, Scripture, and Gospel are those of the morning. Eucharistic Hymn: "Angelic".
In the evening, at the tenth hour, they shall go forth with the Cross and the Gospel and with all adornments in procession, singing the hymn, [Tone] Plagal 4 [Dk]: "The Only-Begotten descended from the Father". Psalm: "This is the day which the Lord has made", Verse: "Give thanks". They shall read the morning scriptures. After this, Alleluia: "There was signed". Gospel according to Matthew 24:27 "For as the lightning" to verse 36 "my words shall not pass away." And they shall sign with the Cross the four corners of the world [Andastan]. Litany: "By Your Holy Cross". Prayer: "Keep us". And then: "Incline Your ear" and "Deliver us". Mesedi: "Now bless [the Lord]", "You who stand in the house". Litany: "Let us say". Dismissal hymn [Hambartsi], [Tone] 3 [Gy]: "Today rejoicing". Litany: "By the Holy Church", "Save". Prayer: "In the midst of this temple".
